title: How to make ramen
original:
How to make ramen 

First get a pot that fits at least four cups of water 
Take a measuring cup and measure 2 cups of water and dump them into the pot we got out not with the measuring cup put the pot on the stove and put on a 9 and wait for the water to boil
Once the water is boiling take the noodles out of the bag or box then put the noodles in the water that is boiling and set a timer for 3 minutes and stir occasionally
Once the 3 minute timer is up take the pot with the noodles and water of the heated surface and turn off the heat
And add the flavor packet wait for the soup to cool to or add ice cubes and eat it like that add chili oil pour it into a bowl and enjoy.

steps.text: First get a pot that fits at least four cups of water

actions.say: A pot that fits at least four cups of water. This one fits six. Perfect!

steps.text: Take a measuring cup and measure 2 cups of water

actions.say: Measuring 2 cups of water at the sink.

steps.note: The student remembered the water, and measured it.

steps.text: and dump them into the pot we got out not with the measuring cup
steps.note: Teacher's choice: 'not with the measuring cup' taken literally. Chef Byte carries the water in its hands. Splashes, but some lands in the pot.

steps.text: put the pot on the stove

actions.say: Put on a 9. The stove dial goes to 9!

steps.note: Teacher's choice: read from context as the stove dial (not wearing a number 9).

steps.text: and wait for the water to boil

actions.say: Waiting for the water to boil...

steps.note: There is water this time, so it boils.

steps.text: Once the water is boiling take the noodles out of the bag or box

actions.say: Bag or box? It's a bag! Rip!

steps.note: Teacher's choice: naming the bag to take them out of counts as opening it.

steps.text: then put the noodles in the water that is boiling
steps.note: Into boiling water: the noodles cook.

steps.text: and set a timer for 3 minutes

steps.note: No spoon named. Teacher's choice: safety stop, no hands in boiling water.

steps.text: Once the 3 minute timer is up take the pot with the noodles and water of the heated surface

actions.say: Taking the pot off the heated surface.
Adding the flavor packet. The whole packet!

steps.note: Never opened, so the packet goes in whole (same rule as sub-003).

steps.text: wait for the soup to cool to or add ice cubes and eat it like that

actions.say: Cool or ice cubes? I pick cool. Waiting for the soup to cool...
Eating it like that, straight from the pot!

steps.note: 'to' read as 'too'. Chef Byte picks the first choice (wait). Then it eats from the pot, because that is the order written.
The lid is still on. Nothing comes out.

steps.text: pour it into a bowl and enjoy.
steps.note: The bowl comes from the cupboard. Chef Byte eats again.

missing: Pour the water in with the measuring cup.
Get a spoon to stir with.
Open the flavor packet and sprinkle it in.
Take the lid off the chili oil.
Put it in the bowl before you eat it.

fixes.text: and pour them into the pot with the measuring cup
and get a spoon and stir occasionally
And open the flavor packet and sprinkle it in
open the chili oil and add chili oil

result: A bowl of cooked noodles with a closed flavor packet in it. Chef Byte already ate some straight from the pot. The chili oil never came out.
